# Toast

```tsx
import { Toaster, Toast, ToastAction, ToastClose, ToastContent, ToastDescription, ToastPortal, ToastProvider, ToastTitle, ToastViewport, createToastManager, toast, useToastManager } from "@lucasdost/design-system"
```

Serve para exibir mensagens rápidas e flutuantes em resposta a ações do usuário, com mínima interrupção da interface.

## Example

From the Storybook story; names like `args` or `label` are the story controls.

```tsx
<>
  <Toaster toastManager={manager} />
  <Button
    variant="secondary"
    onClick={() =>
      manager.promise(
        new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, 2000)),
        {
          loading: { title: "Saving…", type: "loading" },
          success: { title: "Saved", type: "success" },
          error: { title: "Could not save", type: "danger" },
        }
      )
    }
  >
    Save changes
  </Button>
</>
```

## Figma notes

Mirrors the Figma Toast component: Color (Neutral / Accent / Info / Success / Warning / Danger) × Decoration (Icon / Avatar / Image), with Show Title, Show Actions (1 or 2) and Dismissable.
- 380px wide on Background/Inverse/Default, Medium radius, text in Text/Inverse: Title in bold, Description in Body/Medium.
- Color: the `type` passed to toast.add(). Neutral (no type) has a white icon; the others add a 6px ribbon and tint the icon with Toast/Icon/*. "loading" shows the Spinner as the icon. "error" is kept as an alias of "danger".
- Decoration: the icon by default, `data.avatar` (a 32px Avatar) or `data.image` (an 80px image along the left edge).
- Actions: `actionProps` (Action 1) and `data.secondaryAction` (Action 2), as Label/Medium text buttons 16px apart.
- Button Close: a Button Inverse (32px, 16px X), 8px from the corner. Toasts shown at the same time are listed, not stacked on top of each other: the oldest on top, the newest at the bottom.

## Types

`ToastColor`, `ToastData`

## Rules

- Import `Toaster` from `@lucasdost/design-system`. Do not rebuild it with plain HTML and Tailwind classes.
- Style it through its props and variants first. Use `className` only for layout (margin, width, grid placement), never to change its colors, typography or radius.
- Colors come from the S0L tokens; see [color](../foundations/color.md).
